.explore{border-color:#adadad65;color:#c7c7c7;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.1em}.panel{box-shadow:0 20px 70px #00000055}#viewActions{position:absolute;right:20px;top:20px;display:flex;gap:6px;z-index:8}#viewActions button{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.07em;background:#1f1f1fd9;padding:9px 12px}#tourBar{position:absolute;bottom:26px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;border:1px solid #ffffff33;border-radius:8px;padding:14px;background:#202020e8;white-space:nowrap;z-index:9}#tourBar b{display:block;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.15em;color:#c7c7c7}#tourBar span{font-size:10px;color:#b2b2b2}#tourBar>div{margin-right:12px}#tourBar button{font-size:10px;padding:10px 12px}#tourBar button.selected{background:#bcbcbc;color:#222222}body.touring .score,body.touring .health,body.touring .ammo,body.touring .hint,body.touring #feed,body.touring #announcement,body.touring #objective,body.touring #netLabel,body.touring .cross{display:none!important}body.touring #resumeHint{top:55%}#radar{box-shadow:0 8px 30px #00000033;background:#1f1f1fdd}#location{color:#d6d6d6}#hud:after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at center,transparent 55%,#21212120 100%);pointer-events:none}#home{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#171717f2 0%,#1717178a 43%,#17171718 65%,#171717a8 100%)}
@media(max-width:900px){#tourBar{gap:4px;max-width:96vw;white-space:normal;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center}#tourBar>div{width:100%;text-align:center;margin-bottom:4px}.foot{bottom:14px}#viewActions{top:82px}}

body.playing #scene{cursor:none}.health{display:block;min-width:168px}.healthValue{display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:baseline}.healthTrack{height:5px;background:#ffffff33;margin-top:7px;border-radius:3px;overflow:hidden}.healthTrack i{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;background:#cacaca;transition:width .12s ease-out}.health.critical strong,.health.critical small{color:#a1a1a1}.health.critical .healthTrack i{background:#919191}#hitInfo{position:absolute;top:calc(50% + 30px);left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);font-size:11px;font-weight:bold;letter-spacing:.12em;text-shadow:0 1px 4px #000000;background:#1c1c1c80;padding:7px 11px;border-radius:3px;color:#ebebeb}#hitInfo.headshot{color:#d7d7d7;border-bottom:2px solid #c4c4c4}#resumeHint,body.touring #resumeHint{top:auto;bottom:8px;left:50%;background:transparent;border:0;padding:2px;transform:translateX(-50%);font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.06em;white-space:nowrap;color:#ddddddb0;pointer-events:none}body.touring #hitInfo{display:none!important}
#loadout{position:absolute;bottom:92px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);display:flex;gap:4px;pointer-events:auto;max-width:96vw}#loadout button{font:9px Arial;letter-spacing:.08em;padding:10px 12px;background:#1e1e1edc;border:1px solid #ffffff25;white-space:nowrap}#loadout kbd{display:block;width:max-content;margin:0 0 6px;font-size:9px;color:#b8b8b8}#loadout button.selected{color:#d8d8d8;border-bottom:2px solid #c1c1c1;background:#313131ee}#loadout button.selected kbd{color:#d8d8d8;border-color:#bcbcbc77}#loadout #grenadeButton{border-color:#7d7d7d80;color:#cecece}body.touring #loadout{display:none}.netLabel{bottom:62px}.hint{bottom:58px;font-size:9px}#toast{bottom:155px}@media(max-width:900px){#loadout{bottom:118px}#loadout button{padding:8px 6px;font-size:8px}.hint{bottom:93px;font-size:8px}#loadout kbd{font-size:8px}}@media(max-height:580px){#loadout{bottom:82px}.hint{bottom:65px}.keys{gap:10px}}
#tacticalMap{position:absolute;z-index:15;inset:0;background:#101010e8;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;pointer-events:none}#tacticalMap header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;width:min(82vh,90vw);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.1em;padding:10px 0;color:#cfcfcf}#tacticalMap .mapStage{position:relative;width:min(82vh,90vw)}#tacticalMap img{display:block;width:100%;height:auto}#mapMarkers{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%}#radar{border-radius:8px}

/* Persistent left-side score panel keeps the aiming area clear. */
:root{--hud-map:clamp(92px,17vh,152px);--hud-left:18px}
#radar{top:18px;left:var(--hud-left);width:var(--hud-map);height:var(--hud-map)}
.location{left:var(--hud-left);top:calc(28px + var(--hud-map));font-size:10px}
.score{left:var(--hud-left);right:auto;top:calc(49px + var(--hud-map));transform:none;width:248px;padding:8px 12px;gap:12px;justify-content:space-between}
.score>div:first-child,.score>div:last-child{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px;align-items:center}.score>div:last-child{flex-direction:column-reverse}
.score strong{font-size:24px}.score small{font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.07em}.score .clock{font-size:22px;min-width:65px}
#board{left:var(--hud-left);right:auto;top:calc(122px + var(--hud-map));transform:none;width:248px;padding:10px 8px;background:#131313dc;box-shadow:0 5px 20px #00000033;border-radius:6px;pointer-events:none}
.boardHead{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;font-size:9px;padding:1px 4px 7px;letter-spacing:.07em;color:#cccccc}.boardHead span{color:#969696;font-size:8px}
#board table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font:11px Arial,Tahoma,sans-serif;table-layout:auto;margin:0}
#board th{font:8px Arial;color:#a7a7a7;padding:5px 4px;text-align:center}#board th:first-child{text-align:left}
#board td{padding:5px 4px;text-align:center;border-top:1px solid #ffffff0b;line-height:16px}
#board td:first-child{text-align:left;max-width:151px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
#board bdi{font:12px Tahoma,Arial,sans-serif}#board td small{font-size:7px;color:#bababa}
#board .self{background:#bcbcbc15}#board .down{opacity:.42}#board .boardExtra{display:none}
#board.expanded{width:310px;background:#131313f5}#board.expanded .boardExtra{display:table-cell}
body.touring #board,body.touring #bombPanel{display:none!important}
#bombPanel{position:absolute;top:20px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);min-width:205px;padding:12px 18px;border:1px solid #a5a5a577;border-radius:6px;background:#1a1a1ae8;text-align:center;color:#d8d8d8}
#bombPanel small{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.15em;display:block}#bombPanel strong{display:block;font:32px monospace;margin:5px 0}#bombPanel>div{height:3px;background:#ffffff22}#bombMeter{display:block;height:100%;width:100%;background:#bfbfbf}
#bombPanel.urgent{color:#a3a3a3;border-color:#8f8f8f;animation:bombPulse .6s infinite alternate}#bombPanel.urgent #bombMeter{background:#8f8f8f}@keyframes bombPulse{to{box-shadow:0 0 20px #7373732b}}
#viewActions #soundButton{color:#cecece}#viewActions #soundButton.muted{color:#b8b8b8}.audioTest{padding-top:12px;border-top:1px solid #ffffff22}.audioTest button{font-size:10px;white-space:nowrap}.audioTest .note{font-size:11px;margin:0!important}
#home>.panel{padding:25px}#home .field{margin:14px 0}#home .panel h2{font-size:26px}
@media(max-height:720px){#board td{padding:3px 4px;line-height:14px}#board bdi{font-size:11px}#home{padding-top:65px;padding-bottom:45px}#home>.panel{padding:20px}#home .field{margin:10px 0}#home button{padding-top:10px;padding-bottom:10px}#home .panel p{margin:10px 0}#board{top:calc(112px + var(--hud-map))}.score{top:calc(42px + var(--hud-map))}}
@media(max-height:600px){:root{--hud-map:85px}#board td{padding:1px 3px;line-height:14px}#board th{padding:3px}.score{padding:5px 10px}.score strong{font-size:20px}#board{top:190px}.location{top:110px}.score{top:127px}#home{overflow:auto}#home>.panel{margin:10px 0}#board .boardHead{padding-bottom:4px}}
@media(max-width:780px){#board,.score{width:220px}#board td:first-child{max-width:130px}#bombPanel{left:auto;right:15px;top:100px;transform:none;min-width:170px}}
#performanceMeter{position:absolute;right:20px;bottom:110px;z-index:10;padding:7px 10px;background:#1c1c1cb8;border:1px solid #ffffff20;border-radius:4px;color:#d1d1d1;font:10px monospace;pointer-events:none;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.perfNote{font-size:11px;line-height:1.5;color:#b4b4b4;margin:7px 0 14px}#pause .dialog{max-height:92vh;overflow-y:auto}body.touring #performanceMeter{bottom:22px}@media(max-width:900px){#performanceMeter{bottom:185px}}
#recovery{z-index:40}#recoveryDetail{font:11px monospace;white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere;color:#bdbdbd;max-height:100px;overflow:auto}#recovery .dialog{max-width:480px}

@font-face{font-family:Nastaliq;src:url(data:font/woff;base64,) format('woff');font-weight:100 900;font-display:swap}
/* Persian typography and monochrome game-net edition. Font is embedded for offline play. */
:root{--gold:#eee;--paper:#f4f4f4;--muted:#c4c4c4;--panel:#171717ed;--line:#ffffff30;--ct:#fff;--t:#aaa}
body{background:#121212;font:16px/2 'Nastaliq',serif;direction:rtl}
button,input,select,textarea{font-family:'Nastaliq',serif;font-size:17px;line-height:2;letter-spacing:0}
button{padding:7px 16px}button.primary{color:#161616;background:#f2f2f2;font-weight:400}button.primary:hover{background:white}
input,select{padding:3px 12px;min-height:43px;background:#171717;color:#f4f4f4}select option{font-family:'Nastaliq',serif;background:#171717}
button,input,select{outline-offset:4px}button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid white}
.tiny,.pill,.field label,.steps,.hint,.location,.ammo small,.boardHead,#tourBar b,#viewActions button{letter-spacing:0;text-transform:none;font-family:'Nastaliq',serif}
.tiny{font-size:16px}.pill{font-size:15px;padding:2px 18px}.brand{font:33px/2 'Nastaliq',serif;letter-spacing:0}
#home{grid-template-columns:minmax(290px,1fr) 365px;gap:65px;padding:90px 7vw 60px;background:linear-gradient(270deg,#111111f5 0%,#111111bd 35%,#11111130 72%,#111111b0 100%);overflow:auto}
.mast{top:15px}.hero h1{font:clamp(48px,5.5vw,80px)/2 'Nastaliq',serif;letter-spacing:0;margin:0 0 4px}.hero h1 span{display:inline-block;color:#fff}.hero p{font-size:20px;line-height:2.3;max-width:470px;color:#ddd}
.mapBadge{margin-top:22px}.mapBadge b{font-size:22px;font-weight:400}.mapBadge .tiny{font-size:15px}
#home>.panel{padding:20px 26px;background:#111111eb;border:1px solid #ffffff50;box-shadow:0 18px 75px #0005;border-radius:3px}
.panel h2,#home .panel h2{font-size:32px;font-weight:400;line-height:2;margin:0}.panel p{font-size:16px;line-height:2}.panel{background:#161616f4}
#home .field{margin:6px 0}.field label{font-size:15px;margin-bottom:2px;line-height:2}.seg button{font-size:16px;padding:5px 10px}.seg button.selected{color:#fff;border-color:#fff;background:#ffffff12}
.identityFields{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 110px;gap:12px}.secondary{margin-top:7px}.note{font-size:14px!important;line-height:2!important}.explore{color:#ddd;border-color:#fff6;font-size:16px}
.foot{bottom:14px;font-size:13px;line-height:2;color:#ddd;direction:rtl}.foot span{max-width:700px}.foot span:last-child{direction:ltr}
#home .panel p{margin:0 0 8px}.panel .tiny{line-height:1.8}
#hud{direction:rtl}#radar{background:#181818df;border-radius:3px}.location{font-size:17px;top:calc(20px + var(--hud-map));color:#fff!important;line-height:2.2}
.score{background:#141414e8;top:calc(60px + var(--hud-map));width:265px;padding:3px 13px;direction:rtl}.score strong{font:28px/1.8 'Nastaliq',serif}.score small{font:13px/1.8 'Nastaliq',serif;letter-spacing:0}.score .clock{font:24px/1.8 'Nastaliq',serif;direction:ltr}.clock small{font:13px/1.8 'Nastaliq',serif;direction:rtl}
#board{top:calc(144px + var(--hud-map));width:265px;background:#111111e8;padding:5px 8px;direction:rtl;border-radius:3px}
.boardHead{font-size:15px;line-height:2;padding:0 4px}.boardHead span{font-size:12px;color:#ccc}
#board table,#board bdi{font:15px/1.9 'Nastaliq',serif}#board th{font:13px/2 'Nastaliq',serif;color:#ddd;padding:1px 4px}#board td{padding:1px 4px;line-height:1.9}#board td:first-child,#board th:first-child{text-align:right}#board td small{font-size:10px;color:#fff}#board .self{background:#ffffff18}#board.expanded{width:330px}
.health{direction:rtl}.health strong{font:42px/1.6 'Nastaliq',serif}.health small{font-size:19px;letter-spacing:0}.healthTrack i{background:#ddd}.health.critical strong,.health.critical small{color:white}.health.critical .healthTrack i{background:#777}
.ammo{text-align:right;direction:rtl;bottom:20px}.ammo strong{font:38px/1.5 'Nastaliq',serif}.ammo small{font-size:20px;margin:0}.ammo span{font:21px 'Nastaliq',serif}
#loadout{direction:ltr;bottom:85px;gap:6px}#loadout button{font:16px/1.8 'Nastaliq',serif;padding:4px 12px;letter-spacing:0;background:#151515e6}#loadout kbd{font:10px/1.3 monospace;color:#ccc;margin:0 auto 3px}#loadout button.selected{color:#fff;border-color:#fff;background:#424242ed}#loadout button.selected kbd{color:#fff;border-color:#aaa}#loadout #grenadeButton{color:#fff;border-color:#aaa}
.hint{bottom:45px;font-size:13px;line-height:2;white-space:normal;text-align:center;width:52%}#resumeHint,body.touring #resumeHint{font-size:12px;color:#ddd;letter-spacing:0;bottom:5px;max-width:90vw}
#feed{font-size:16px;line-height:2;top:95px}.feedrow{background:#181818df}#announcement{font-size:40px;font-weight:400;line-height:2.1}#announcement small{font-size:20px;margin-top:0}#objective{font-size:20px;line-height:2.1;bottom:23%}
#hitInfo{font-size:17px;letter-spacing:0;background:#111a}#hitInfo.headshot{color:#fff;border-color:#fff}
#bombPanel{background:#141414ed;color:#fff;border-color:#aaa;padding:6px 18px}#bombPanel small{font-size:18px;letter-spacing:0}#bombPanel strong{font:30px/1.7 'Nastaliq',serif}#bombMeter{background:#ddd}#bombPanel.urgent{color:#fff;border-color:#fff;animation:bombPulse .6s infinite alternate}#bombPanel.urgent #bombMeter{background:#fff}@keyframes bombPulse{to{box-shadow:0 0 20px #ffffff3b}}
#viewActions button{font-size:17px;background:#111d;padding:3px 12px}#viewActions #soundButton,#viewActions #soundButton.muted{color:#eee}
#tourBar{background:#111e;direction:rtl;padding:7px 15px}#tourBar b{font-size:21px;color:#fff}#tourBar span{font-size:15px}#tourBar button{font-size:17px;padding:4px 12px}#tourBar button.selected{color:#111;background:#eee}
.dialog{max-height:92vh}.dialog h2{font-size:32px}.settings{font-size:18px;margin:10px 0}.keys{font-size:16px;gap:10px;margin:15px 0}.keys kbd,kbd{font:11px/1.8 monospace;direction:ltr;display:inline-block;margin-left:6px;margin-right:0}.perfNote{font-size:15px;line-height:2}.audioTest button{font-size:16px}
.steps{font-size:17px}.codes{font:12px/1.4 monospace;direction:ltr}.netButtons button{font-size:17px}.status{font-size:16px;line-height:2;border-left:0;border-right:2px solid white}.roster span{font-size:16px}.netLabel{font:13px/2 'Nastaliq',serif;bottom:75px}
#performanceMeter{font:13px/1.8 'Nastaliq',serif;background:#111d;color:#ddd;bottom:115px}#toast{font-size:18px;line-height:2;background:#181818f5;bottom:170px}
#tacticalMap{background:#090909f5}#tacticalMap header{font:19px/2 'Nastaliq',serif;color:#eee;letter-spacing:0;width:min(80vh,85vw)}#tacticalMap .mapStage{width:min(80vh,85vw);aspect-ratio:1}#mapMarkers{position:static;width:100%;height:100%}
#recoveryDetail{font-family:'Nastaliq',monospace;color:#ddd;font-size:14px}.cross,.cross:before,.cross:after{background:white}#hud:after{background:radial-gradient(ellipse at center,transparent 55%,#0002 100%)}
@media(max-height:820px){#home{padding-top:70px;padding-bottom:45px}.hero h1{font-size:58px}#home>.panel{padding:10px 22px}#home .panel h2{font-size:27px}#home .field{margin:3px 0}#home input,#home select{min-height:36px;height:38px}#home button{padding-top:2px;padding-bottom:2px}#home .note{font-size:12px!important}.foot{font-size:11px}#home>.panel>.tiny{font-size:13px}#board bdi,#board table{font-size:13px}#board th{font-size:12px}#board{top:calc(133px + var(--hud-map))}.score{top:calc(54px + var(--hud-map))}}
@media(max-width:1000px){#home{gap:24px;padding-left:4vw;padding-right:4vw}.hero h1{font-size:50px}.hero p{font-size:18px}.score,#board{width:225px}#loadout button{padding:3px 7px;font-size:14px}.hint{font-size:11px;width:55%}}
@media(max-width:680px){#home{display:block}.hero{display:none}#home>.panel{max-width:370px;margin:auto}.foot{display:none}.pill{display:none}#board{width:195px}.score{width:195px}#viewActions{top:12px}.hint{width:72%;bottom:66px}#loadout{bottom:104px}.health{left:16px}.ammo{right:16px}#tourBar{bottom:18px}#tourBar button{font-size:14px}.keys{grid-template-columns:1fr}.settings{font-size:16px}}
@media(max-height:620px){#board{top:210px}#board td{line-height:1.65}.score{top:124px}.location{top:102px}.score strong{font-size:21px}.score small{font-size:11px}#board th{padding:0}.boardHead{font-size:12px}#home{align-items:start}.hero{padding-top:40px}.health strong{font-size:28px}}

/* The HUD is laid out in independent flow containers; text never anchors itself to the viewport. */
:root{--hud-left:16px;--hud-side:252px;--hud-right:288px;--hud-bottom:132px;--hud-map:118px}
#hud{position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;isolation:isolate}
#hudLeft{position:absolute;left:var(--hud-left);top:16px;bottom:var(--hud-bottom);width:var(--hud-side);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;gap:8px;min-height:0;direction:rtl;z-index:3}
#mapSummary{flex:none;min-height:0;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;direction:ltr}
#radar{position:static;inset:auto;transform:none;width:var(--hud-map);height:var(--hud-map);flex:none;border-radius:5px}
#location{position:static;inset:auto;transform:none;max-width:112px;margin:0;direction:rtl;overflow-wrap:anywhere;font:16px/2.3 Nastaliq,serif;text-shadow:0 1px 4px #000}
.score{position:static;inset:auto;transform:none;flex:none;width:100%;min-height:70px;margin:0;padding:5px 12px;gap:10px;border-radius:5px;direction:rtl}
.score strong{font:25px/1.35 Nastaliq,serif}.score small,.clock small{font:12px/2 Nastaliq,serif;white-space:nowrap;margin:0}
.score .clock{font:22px/1.6 Nastaliq,serif;min-width:64px}.score>div:first-child,.score>div:last-child{gap:0}
#board{position:static;inset:auto;transform:none;flex:0 1 auto;min-height:0;width:100%;max-width:none;max-height:100%;margin:0;padding:5px 7px;overflow:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain;scrollbar-width:thin;border-radius:5px;pointer-events:none}
.boardHead{font:14px/2.25 Nastaliq,serif;padding:0 3px;white-space:nowrap}.boardHead span{font-size:11px}
#board table{width:100%;table-layout:fixed;font:13px/2.25 Nastaliq,serif}#board th{font:11px/2.4 Nastaliq,serif;padding:0 2px;height:27px}#board th:first-child{width:58%}
#board td{padding:0 2px;line-height:2.25;height:29px;vertical-align:middle}#board bdi{font:13px/2.25 Nastaliq,serif;unicode-bidi:isolate}#board td:first-child{max-width:none;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
#board td small{font:9px/2.2 Nastaliq,serif;margin-inline-start:3px}#board.expanded{width:100%;max-width:none;pointer-events:auto;background:#111f}#board.expanded th:first-child{width:46%}
#hudRight{position:absolute;right:16px;top:16px;width:var(--hud-right);max-height:calc(100% - var(--hud-bottom) - 16px);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;min-height:0;z-index:4;overflow:hidden}
#viewActions{position:static;inset:auto;transform:none;display:flex;justify-content:flex-start;gap:6px;flex:none;direction:rtl;pointer-events:auto}
#viewActions button{flex:1;min-width:0;font:15px/2.3 Nastaliq,serif;white-space:nowrap;padding:3px 8px;min-height:42px;background:#141414e8}
#feed{position:static;inset:auto;transform:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;width:100%;min-width:0;max-height:186px;overflow:hidden;direction:rtl;text-align:right;font:14px/2.4 Nastaliq,serif;pointer-events:none}
.feedrow{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;width:100%;min-width:0;margin:0;padding:2px 10px;height:40px;border:1px solid #ffffff20;border-right:2px solid #bbb;border-radius:4px;background:#151515d9;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden}
.feedrow bdi{flex:1;min-width:0;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;unicode-bidi:isolate;font-weight:400}.feedrow .feedAction{flex:none;font-size:11px;opacity:.7}
#sessionStatus{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;padding:0 3px;flex-wrap:wrap;direction:rtl}
#performanceMeter,#netLabel{position:static;inset:auto;transform:none;margin:0;padding:1px 5px;border:0;background:#1119;border-radius:3px;font:12px/2.2 Nastaliq,serif;color:#ddd;max-width:100%;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
#hudBottom{position:absolute;left:16px;right:16px;bottom:14px;height:102px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:176px minmax(0,1fr) 176px;gap:22px;align-items:end;direction:ltr;z-index:3}
#healthPanel,.ammo{position:static;inset:auto;transform:none;min-width:0;width:100%;margin:0;direction:rtl;padding:0 4px}
.healthValue{gap:9px;justify-content:flex-end;align-items:baseline}.health strong{font:36px/1.5 Nastaliq,serif}.health small{font:15px/2 Nastaliq,serif;white-space:nowrap}.healthTrack{margin-top:4px}
.ammo{height:90px;text-align:right;overflow:hidden}.ammo small{font:17px/2 Nastaliq,serif;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;margin:0}.ammo strong{font:34px/1.5 Nastaliq,serif}.ammo span{font:19px/1.5 Nastaliq,serif}
#weaponDock{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:end;gap:5px;min-width:0;max-width:650px;width:100%;margin:auto}
#loadout{position:static;inset:auto;transform:none;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(7,minmax(0,1fr));gap:4px;width:100%;max-width:none;min-width:0;direction:ltr}
#loadout button{min-width:0;height:57px;font:14px/2 Nastaliq,serif;padding:3px 4px;overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap;border-radius:4px}
#loadout kbd{font:10px/1.3 monospace;display:block;margin:0 auto 2px;padding:1px 3px}
.hint{position:static;inset:auto;transform:none;max-width:100%;width:100%;margin:0;height:28px;font:12px/2.3 Nastaliq,serif;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;text-align:center;direction:rtl}
#resumeHint,body.touring #resumeHint{position:static;inset:auto;transform:none;max-width:100%;width:100%;font:12px/2.3 Nastaliq,serif;line-height:2.3;white-space:normal;overflow-wrap:anywhere;text-align:right;padding:5px 8px;border:1px solid #ffffff22;background:#111b;border-radius:4px;pointer-events:none}
#bombPanel{position:absolute;top:18px;left:calc(var(--hud-side) + 38px);right:calc(var(--hud-right) + 38px);transform:none;min-width:0;width:auto;max-width:260px;margin:0 auto;padding:5px 12px;z-index:2}
#bombPanel small{font:15px/2.2 Nastaliq,serif}#bombPanel strong{font:27px/1.5 Nastaliq,serif;margin:0}
#announcement{top:150px;left:calc(var(--hud-side) + 32px);right:calc(var(--hud-right) + 32px);width:auto;transform:none;font:30px/2.2 Nastaliq,serif;overflow-wrap:anywhere;z-index:1}
#announcement small{font:17px/2.2 Nastaliq,serif}#announcement:empty,#objective:empty,#feed:empty{display:none}
#objective{bottom:144px;left:calc(var(--hud-side) + 30px);right:calc(var(--hud-right) + 30px);width:auto;transform:none;font:17px/2.2 Nastaliq,serif;padding:4px 8px;border-radius:5px;background:#1119;overflow-wrap:anywhere;z-index:2}
#bar{width:90%;max-width:230px;margin:6px auto}
#toast{left:calc(var(--hud-side) + 32px);right:calc(var(--hud-right) + 32px);bottom:235px;transform:none;width:auto;max-width:none;font:16px/2.3 Nastaliq,serif;text-align:center}
#tourBar{left:calc(var(--hud-side) + 32px);right:16px;bottom:18px;transform:none;max-width:none;width:auto;white-space:normal;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;padding:8px;gap:6px}
#tourBar>div{margin:0 8px;min-width:130px}#tourBar button{font:15px/2.2 Nastaliq,serif;padding:4px 10px}
body.touring #hudBottom,body.touring #feed,body.touring #board,body.touring .score,body.touring #objective,body.touring #announcement,body.touring #bombPanel{display:none!important}
body.touring #performanceMeter{position:static;inset:auto}body:not(.playing) #hud{display:none!important}
#home{grid-template-rows:auto 1fr auto;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 365px;align-items:center;gap:20px 48px;padding:24px 6vw;overflow:auto}
#home .mast{position:static;grid-column:1/-1;inset:auto;min-width:0;gap:16px}#home .foot{position:static;grid-column:1/-1;inset:auto;margin-top:12px;gap:24px}
#home>.panel{width:100%;max-width:none;margin:0}#home .hero{min-width:0}.dialog{width:min(620px,100%)!important;max-height:calc(100% - 24px);padding:20px;overflow:auto}.modal{padding:12px}.settings{flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}.settings select{max-width:100%}
@media(max-height:760px){:root{--hud-map:84px;--hud-bottom:126px}#mapSummary{gap:10px}.score{min-height:62px}.score strong{font-size:22px}#board table,#board bdi{font-size:12px}#board td{height:26px;line-height:2.2}.boardHead{font-size:13px;line-height:2.1}#board th{height:24px;font-size:10px}#home{padding:16px 5vw;gap:12px 24px}#home .hero h1{font-size:50px}#home .foot{margin:0}}
@media(max-width:1100px){:root{--hud-side:218px;--hud-right:252px}#hudBottom{grid-template-columns:142px minmax(0,1fr) 142px;gap:12px}#loadout button{font-size:12px}#viewActions button{font-size:13px;padding-inline:5px}.healthValue{gap:5px}.health small{font-size:13px}.ammo small{font-size:15px}}
@media(max-width:850px){:root{--hud-side:194px;--hud-right:222px;--hud-left:12px;--hud-map:74px}#hudLeft{top:12px}#hudRight{top:12px;right:12px}.feedrow{font-size:12px;height:34px;padding:1px 6px}#feed{max-height:151px}#viewActions button{font-size:12px;padding:3px}.score{padding:4px 6px;gap:3px}#board table,#board bdi{font-size:11px}#board th:first-child{width:57%}.boardHead{font-size:11px}.boardHead span{font-size:9px}#hudBottom{left:12px;right:12px;gap:8px;grid-template-columns:112px minmax(0,1fr) 112px}.health small{font-size:11px}.health strong{font-size:29px}.ammo strong{font-size:29px}#loadout button{font-size:11px;padding:3px 1px}#loadout kbd{font-size:9px}.hint{font-size:10px}#location{font-size:14px}#announcement{font-size:24px}#announcement small{font-size:14px}#objective{font-size:14px}#home{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center}#home>.hero{display:none}#home>.panel{max-width:390px}#home .mast{width:100%}#home .foot{display:flex;width:100%;font-size:11px}#home .foot span:last-child{display:none}}
@media(max-height:530px){:root{--hud-bottom:112px;--hud-map:0px}#mapSummary{min-height:24px}#radar{display:none}#location{font-size:13px;line-height:2;max-width:100%;width:100%;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}#hudLeft{gap:5px}.score{min-height:55px}.score strong{font-size:20px}.score .clock{font-size:18px}.score small{font-size:10px}#board table,#board bdi{font-size:11px}#board td{height:25px}#board .boardHead{font-size:11px}#hudBottom{bottom:8px;height:90px}#loadout button{height:52px}#feed{max-height:110px}.feedrow{height:32px;flex-shrink:0}#announcement{top:115px;font-size:22px;line-height:1.8}#announcement small{font-size:13px}#bombPanel{padding:3px 8px}#bombPanel strong{font-size:22px}#bombPanel small{font-size:12px}#objective{bottom:116px;font-size:13px}#toast{bottom:168px}#resumeHint{display:none!important}}
@media(max-width:650px){:root{--hud-side:166px;--hud-right:180px;--hud-map:62px}#hudRight{gap:6px}#viewActions{gap:3px}#viewActions button{font-size:11px;min-height:36px}.feedrow{font-size:11px}.feedrow .feedAction{font-size:9px}#netLabel{font-size:10px}#performanceMeter{font-size:10px}#bombPanel,#announcement{left:190px;right:12px}#announcement{top:275px}#objective{left:190px;right:12px;bottom:126px}#hudBottom{grid-template-columns:90px minmax(0,1fr) 90px;gap:6px}#weaponDock{gap:3px}#loadout{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:3px}#loadout button{height:40px;font-size:10px;line-height:1.5}#loadout kbd{font-size:8px;padding:0;margin-bottom:1px}.hint{display:none}.healthValue{gap:4px;flex-wrap:wrap}.health strong{font-size:26px}.health small{font-size:10px}.ammo small{font-size:12px}.ammo strong{font-size:27px}.ammo span{font-size:13px}#tourBar{left:190px;padding:6px}#tourBar>div{min-width:0;width:100%;text-align:center}#tourBar button{font-size:12px;padding:3px 7px}#toast{left:190px;right:12px}#location{font-size:12px}.score small{font-size:10px}#board th:first-child{width:55%}}
/* Objective and round messages share the right stack, rather than covering each other or the aim. */
#bombPanel{position:static;inset:auto;transform:none;flex:none;width:100%;min-width:0;max-width:none;margin:0;padding:3px 10px}
#bombPanel small{font-size:13px;line-height:2}#bombPanel strong{font-size:23px;line-height:1.5}
#announcement,#objective{position:static;inset:auto;transform:none;width:100%;min-width:0;max-width:none;flex:none;margin:0;padding:5px 10px;background:#111c;border-radius:4px;text-align:right;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
#announcement{font:23px/2 Nastaliq,serif}#announcement small{font:14px/2.3 Nastaliq,serif}#objective{font:14px/2.3 Nastaliq,serif}
@media(max-height:530px){#announcement{font-size:18px}#announcement small{font-size:12px}#objective{font-size:12px}#sessionStatus{display:none}#bombPanel strong{font-size:20px}}
@media(max-width:450px){:root{--hud-side:148px;--hud-right:170px;--hud-bottom:126px}#hudLeft{left:8px}#hudRight{right:8px}#hudBottom{left:8px;right:8px;grid-template-columns:70px minmax(0,1fr) 70px;gap:5px}#board table,#board bdi{font-size:10px}#board th{font-size:9px}.boardHead span{display:none}#mapSummary{display:block}#radar{display:none}#location{font-size:12px}#viewActions button{font-size:10px}#toast{left:12px;right:12px;bottom:140px}#tourBar{left:168px;right:8px}.ammo small{font-size:11px}}

#hudBrand{font:16px/2.1 Nastaliq,serif;color:#eee;white-space:nowrap;padding:0 5px;text-shadow:0 1px 3px #000}

/* Eight fixed loadout columns; the utility additions stay in the existing bottom dock. */
#loadout{grid-template-columns:repeat(8,minmax(0,1fr))}#loadout button{min-width:0;white-space:normal}#loadout .empty{opacity:.45}
#knifeBanner{position:absolute;left:50%;top:29%;transform:translateX(-50%);width:min(580px,58vw);padding:10px 26px 22px;text-align:center;pointer-events:none;font:clamp(28px,4vw,60px)/2 Nastaliq,serif;color:#fff;background:radial-gradient(ellipse,#171717df,transparent 73%);text-shadow:0 3px 10px #000;z-index:3;overflow-wrap:anywhere;animation:knifeReveal .25s ease-out}
@keyframes knifeReveal{from{opacity:0;transform:translateX(-50%) scale(1.12)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateX(-50%) scale(1)}}
body.touring #knifeBanner{display:none!important}@media(max-width:850px){#loadout button{padding-left:1px;padding-right:1px;font-size:10px}}@media(max-width:650px){#loadout{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))}#knifeBanner{width:60vw;left:60%;font-size:27px;top:37%;padding:6px 10px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){#knifeBanner{animation:none}}


/* Quiet start screen: live architecture, one title, four text actions. */
#home{position:fixed;inset:0;display:flex;flex-direction:row;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:center;gap:0;padding:48px 8vw;overflow:auto;direction:rtl;background:linear-gradient(270deg,rgba(8,8,8,.73),rgba(8,8,8,.32) 44%,rgba(8,8,8,.08) 78%)}
#home .startMenu{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;flex:none;width:360px;max-width:100%;margin:0;padding:12px 0;text-align:right}
#home h1{font:128px/1.65 Nastaliq,serif;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:0;white-space:nowrap;margin:0 0 28px;color:#fff;text-shadow:0 2px 24px #0005}
#home .startLinks{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:3px;width:100%}
#home .startLinks button{display:block;min-height:51px;padding:2px 0;margin:0;max-width:100%;font:23px/2.2 Nastaliq,serif;letter-spacing:0;white-space:nowrap;text-align:right;border:0;border-radius:0;background:transparent;box-shadow:none;color:#dedede;text-shadow:0 2px 12px #0009;transition:color .2s,transform .2s}
#home .startLinks button:hover{color:#fff;transform:translateX(-6px);background:transparent}
#home .startLinks button:focus-visible{color:#fff;outline:none;text-decoration:underline;text-decoration-thickness:1px;text-underline-offset:8px;background:transparent}
#home #menuMusicToggle{margin-top:30px;padding:3px 0;min-height:36px;border:0;background:none;box-shadow:none;font:16px/2 Nastaliq,serif;color:#bdbdbd;text-shadow:0 2px 8px #0009}#home #menuMusicToggle:hover{color:white}
#startSettings{background:#0d0d0ddc;backdrop-filter:blur(7px);padding:28px;direction:rtl}
#startSettings .startOptions{width:420px;max-width:100%;max-height:100%;overflow:auto;padding:12px 6px;scrollbar-width:thin}
#startSettings header{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:24px;margin-bottom:20px}
#startSettings h2{font:32px/2 Nastaliq,serif;margin:0;font-weight:400}
#startSettings header button{border:0;background:transparent;padding:3px 0;color:#ccc;font-size:20px}
#startSettings .field{margin:17px 0}#startSettings label{font:17px/2 Nastaliq,serif;letter-spacing:0;color:#bbb}
#startSettings input,#startSettings select{border:0;border-bottom:1px solid #ffffff42;border-radius:0;background:#17171799;padding:7px 10px;min-height:48px;font-size:18px}
#startSettings .seg button{background:transparent;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid #ffffff30;border-radius:0;min-height:45px}
#startSettings .seg button.selected{border-color:#fff;color:#fff;background:transparent}
@media(max-width:850px){#home{padding:32px 8vw;display:flex;flex-direction:row}#home h1{font-size:104px}#home .startMenu{width:320px}#home .startLinks button{font-size:22px}}
@media(max-width:480px){#home{padding:28px 9vw;align-items:center}#home h1{font-size:86px;margin-bottom:22px}#home .startLinks button{font-size:22px;min-height:52px}#startSettings{padding:18px}#startSettings .identityFields{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 100px}}
@media(max-height:560px){#home{padding:18px 8vw}#home h1{font-size:78px;line-height:1.5;margin-bottom:12px}#home .startLinks{gap:0}#home .startLinks button{font-size:19px;line-height:2.2;min-height:42px}#home .startMenu{padding:0}#startSettings header{margin-bottom:8px}#startSettings .field{margin:10px 0}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){#home .startLinks button{transition:none}#home .startLinks button:hover{transform:none}}


#home .buildStamp{font:15px/1.8 Nastaliq,serif;color:#bfbfbf;margin-top:-32px;margin-bottom:22px}
#home #operatorLoadStatus{font:14px/1.7 Nastaliq,serif;color:#bababa;max-width:290px;margin:13px 0 0}
#home #operatorPreviewControls{margin-top:18px;max-width:350px}#home .operatorChoices{display:flex;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap}
#home #operatorPreviewControls button,#home #retryOperators{background:none;border:0;padding:3px 0;font:17px/2 Nastaliq,serif;color:#c5c5c5}
#home .operatorChoices button[aria-pressed="true"]{color:white;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:6px}
#home #closeOperatorPreview{margin-right:18px}#home #menuMusicToggle{margin-top:12px}

</style></head><body data-build="30"><style>
#loadingScreen{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:1000;background:#141414;color:#eee;display:grid;place-items:center;text-align:center;direction:rtl;font-family:Nastaliq,serif}#loadingScreen[hidden]{display:none}#loadingScreen .loadContent{width:min(340px,80vw)}#loadingScreen h1{font:normal 64px/1.8 Nastaliq,serif;margin:0 0 22px}#loadingScreen p{font:18px/2 Nastaliq,serif;min-height:2em;margin:14px 0}#loadProgress{direction:ltr;display:block;width:100%;height:3px;appearance:none;border:0;border-radius:0;background:#3b3b3b}#loadProgress::-webkit-progress-bar{background:#3b3b3b}#loadProgress::-webkit-progress-value{background:#d7d7d7}#loadProgress::-moz-progress-bar{background:#d7d7d7}#loadPercent{font:14px sans-serif;color:#aaa;display:block;margin-top:16px}#loadRetry{margin:auto;background:transparent;color:#fff;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid #777;font:18px Nastaliq,serif;cursor:pointer}#loadingScreen small{color:#8f8f8f;font:12px sans-serif}
</style>
<section id="loadingScreen" role="status" aria-live="polite" aria-label="بارگذاری غبار ۲"><div class="loadContent"><h1>غبار ۲</h1><progress id="loadProgress" max="100" aria-label="پیشرفت آماده‌سازی"></progress><p id="loadLabel">در حال دریافت بازی…</p><span id="loadPercent"></span><button id="loadRetry" type="button" hidden>تلاش دوباره</button><small>نسخهٔ ۳۰</small></div></section>
<noscript><div style="position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:1001;background:#141414;color:white;padding:20vh 10vw;text-align:center">برای اجرای بازی جاوااسکریپت مرورگر را روشن کن.</div></noscript>
<script id="loading-bootstrap">// Installed before the embedded assets: visible while the HTML is still arriving.
(()=>{
 const by=id=>document.getElementById(id),state={ready:false,failed:false,started:false,retry:null};
 function lock(on){for(const id of ['practice','friends','explore','previewOperators']){const e=by(id);if(e)e.disabled=on;}const home=by('home');if(home){home.inert=on;home.setAttribute('aria-busy',String(on));}}
 function stage(percent,text){if(state.ready)return;by('loadLabel').textContent=text;const bar=by('loadProgress');bar.value=percent;bar.setAttribute('aria-valuetext',text);by('loadPercent').textContent=new Intl.NumberFormat('fa').format(percent)+'٪';}
 function fail(message,retry){state.failed=true;state.ready=false;state.retry=retry||(()=>location.reload());lock(true);by('loadLabel').textContent=message;by('loadRetry').hidden=false;by('loadProgress').removeAttribute('value');by('loadingScreen').hidden=false;}
 const paint=()=>new Promise(resolve=>requestAnimationFrame(()=>requestAnimationFrame(resolve)));
 window.ghbBoot={state,stage,paint,fail,get ready(){return state.ready},
  async launch(start){state.started=true;lock(true);stage(12,'فایل بازی دریافت شد؛ آماده‌سازی قلم…');await paint();try{if(document.fonts)await document.fonts.load('32px Nastaliq');stage(20,'ساخت نقشه و آماده‌سازی تصویر…');await paint();start();}catch(e){console.error(e);fail('آماده‌سازی کامل نشد؛ دوباره امتحان کن.');}},
  async complete(){if(state.ready)return;state.failed=false;stage(100,'همه‌چیز آماده است');await paint();state.ready=true;lock(false);by('loadingScreen').hidden=true;by('loadRetry').hidden=true;},
  retryWith(fn){state.retry=fn;}
 };
 window.addEventListener?.('load',()=>{if(!state.started)fail('دریافت فایل کامل نشد؛ دوباره بارگذاری کن.');});
 by('loadRetry').onclick=()=>{by('loadRetry').hidden=true;state.failed=false;Promise.resolve().then(()=>state.retry?.()).catch(e=>fail('بارگذاری کامل نشد؛ دوباره امتحان کن.'));};
})();
</script>
